claims.claim: The applicant must not already receive National Insurance credits through Carer’s Allowance.
claims.quote: get Carer’s Allowance or Carer Support Payment - you’ll automatically get credits
claims.note: Carer’s Allowance brings automatic credits so a separate Carer’s Credit application is unnecessary, but the text does not state an eligibility bar.

claims.claim: The applicant must not already receive National Insurance credits through Universal Credit.
claims.quote: If you receive Universal Credit, you get Class 3 credits automatically.
claims.note: Universal Credit provides automatic Class 3 credits, but the text does not say this disqualifies a Carer’s Credit applicant.

claims.claim: The applicant must not already receive National Insurance credits through earnings above the Lower Earnings Limit.
claims.note: The supplied sources do not mention this earnings threshold or an exclusion based on it.
